programs.title: Getaway
programs.desc: This week on Getaway, showcasing how to do Bora Bora on a budget, cruising around Turkey plus going back to the time of the dinosaurs in outback Queensland.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple and their toddler are eager to plant roots at their woodsy lot. Mika and Brian must deliver a home that exceeds their expectations.

programs.sub_title: Take Me Out of My Reno!
programs.desc: After ripping apart their entire house, first time homeowners have learned they don't have the experience or time to make a renovation happen. Now, Jasmine has just six weeks to transform their kitchen, living room and bedroom into a beach-style oasis.

programs.title: Chateau DIY
programs.desc: Anna and Edward wrestle an enormous fig tree before it forces the wedding terrace wall to come crashing down. Chris and Jolyon are in despair as they battle to turn a muddy pit into a beautiful natural pond.

programs.title: Small Town Potential
programs.desc: A chef and his wife look to put down roots near family in the Hudson Valley and want a home with a great kitchen and room to grow. Davina and Kristin are challenged with a modest budget and tight spaces to deliver a house that's both fun and functional.

programs.title: Renovation Nation
programs.desc: On Humberside, Lucy and Seb make big strides to see if their sweeping staircase can be saved. And in Shropshire, Alan and Catherine cook up an al fresco living space.
